author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: We need to be clear about the validation gate. The model evaluation harness is currently manual, and that is by design. Every test case is documented by hand, and the sign off requires a full review of the results before any model change is considered. I will not approve a model if the harness is automated. The documentation trail is the only way to ensure that a new weather feature has not introduced a silent failure. If we automate the harness, we lose the rigorous check that every edge case is handled correctly. I am not willing to trade that safety for speed. The line is drawn: no automated harness, no model approval. We keep it manual, and we keep it governed.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they will not approve a model if the harness is automated and defines this refusal as the line that must not be crossed.
